decisions: Which element does a frost ward draw from? Water and Air are both plausible; ARCH-001 forbids Fire outright, so the choice changes whether this mission can be done at all within the current policy.
Must the frost ward interoperate with the existing shield and ward spells, or does it stand alone? 'Where that makes sense' is not a boundary anyone can implement against.
